clips.title: Aisle One Pull
clips.prompt: Medium-wide of green sculpture pulling rack; short forward shift as ceiling grid loosens, fluorescent tube arcs and falls, smashes onto toy shelf, crushed tin car with bent key; imperfect exposure, mixed daylight and practical fluorescents. Viewpoint: short forward shift Use one physically coherent, continuous viewpoint movement chosen to reveal the event. Use one restrained viewpoint movement at most. End state: a fluorescent tube smokes and a tin wind-up car is crushed; its wind-up key is bent and lodged in the wreckage Animate the exact canonical protagonist already visible in the start frame and preserve its identity through the motion.
